package ssa

import (
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	LOWER_IMPORT
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotGenericFrontend struct {
	Frontend
	splits []string
}

func (*snapshotGenericFrontend) Log() bool { return false }
func (*snapshotGenericFrontend) Fatalf(pos src.XPos, f string, args ...any) {
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", pos.Line(), fmt.Sprintf(f, args...)))
}
func (*snapshotGenericFrontend) Warnl(src.XPos, string, ...any) {}
func (fe *snapshotGenericFrontend) SplitSlot(parent *LocalSlot, suffix string, offset int64, t *types.Type) LocalSlot {
	// The fixture uses parameter slots. Keep the existing Name and accumulate its
	// offset, exactly the non-auto branch of the native Frontend contract.
	if parent.N.Class != ir.PPARAM {
		panic("fixture expects a parameter slot")
	}
	fe.splits = append(fe.splits, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%d/%v", parent.N.Sym().Name, suffix, offset, t))
	return LocalSlot{N: parent.N, Type: t, Off: parent.Off + offset}
}
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"), 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386", "mips":
		target.size = 4
	}
	switch target.arch {
	case "mips", "ppc64":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	SETUP
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOAMD64 = 1
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.Version = 7
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOPPC64 = 8
	LOWER_FEATURES.GORISCV64 = 20
	switch target.arch {
	case "386":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.I386
	case "amd64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.AMD64
	case "arm64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.ARM64
	case "mips":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.MIPS
	case "ppc64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.PPC64
	}
	cfg := UP.NewConfig(target.arch, *UP.NewTypes(), LINK, true, false)
	ty := cfg.Types
	var out []string
	add := func(label string, args ...any) { out = append(out, label+":"+fmt.Sprint(args...)) }
	file := src.NewFileBase("generic.go", "generic.go")
	pos := LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(file, 10, 1))
	fresh := func() (*Func, *snapshotGenericFrontend) {
		cache := new(Cache)
		cache.Reset()
		fe := &snapshotGenericFrontend{}
		f := cfg.NewFunc(fe, cache)
		f.Name = "generic"
		f.Type = TY.NewSignature(nil, nil, nil)
		f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI1
		f.pass = &pass{name: "generic"}
		f.Entry = f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		f.Entry.Pos = pos
		return f, fe
	}
	constInt := func(f *Func, k int64) *Value {
		if target.size == 4 {
			return f.ConstInt32(ty.Int, int32(k))
		}
		return f.ConstInt64(ty.Int, k)
	}
	finish := func(label string, f *Func, fe *snapshotGenericFrontend) {
		checkFunc(f)
		numberLines(f)
		decomposeUser(f)
		opt(f)
		divisible(f)
		divmod(f)
		decomposeBuiltin(f)
		softfloat(f)
		opt(f)
		deadcode(f)
		f.invalidateCFG()
		checkFunc(f)
		add(label+"-generic", f.String())
		add(label+"-splits", fe.splits)
		for _, n := range f.Names {
			add(label+"-name", n, " ", f.NamedValues[*n])
		}
		lower(f)
		lateLower(f)
		deadcode(f)
		f.invalidateCFG()
		checkFunc(f)
		checkLower(f)
		add(label+"-lower", f.String())
	}
	// A signed constant division and a remainder comparison exercise the native
	// divmod and divisible callbacks before 64-bit shift counts are decomposed.
	for _, d := range []int32{3, 7, 8, 17, -3} {
		f, fe := fresh()
		b := f.Entry
		x := b.NewValue0(pos, OpArg, ty.Int32)
		divisor := f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, d)
		q := b.NewValue2(pos, OpDiv32, ty.Int32, x, divisor)
		rem := b.NewValue2(pos, OpMod32, ty.Int32, x, divisor)
		equal := b.NewValue2(pos, OpEq32, ty.Bool, rem, f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, 0))
		pred := b.NewValue1(pos, OpCvtBoolToUint8, ty.UInt8, equal)
		wide := b.NewValue1(pos, OpZeroExt8to32, ty.Int32, pred)
		result := b.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd32, ty.Int32, q, wide)
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		ptr := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, ty.Int32Ptr, 8)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int32, ptr, result, mem)
		b.SetControl(mem)
		finish(fmt.Sprint("division-", d), f, fe)
	}
	{
		f, fe := fresh()
		b := f.Entry
		GRAPH.Syms.Zerobase = &obj.LSym{Name: "runtime.zerobase"}
		info := cfg.ABI1.ABIAnalyzeTypes([]*types.Type{ty.BytePtr, ty.Int, ty.Int}, []*types.Type{ty.BytePtr})
		aux := StaticAuxCall(&obj.LSym{Name: "runtime.makeslice"}, info)
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		call := b.NewValue0A(pos, OpStaticLECall, aux.LateExpansionResultType(), aux)
		call.AddArgs(f.ConstNil(ty.BytePtr), constInt(f, 0), constInt(f, 0), mem)
		ptr := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, ty.BytePtr, 0, call)
		next := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, TY.TypeMem, 1, call)
		result := b.NewValue2(pos, OpMakeResult, TY.TypeMem, ptr, next)
		b.SetControl(result)
		finish("empty-allocation", f, fe)
	}

	// Compound values enter through real constructors, not aggregate Arg nodes
	// that need the separately migrated call-expansion stage.
	nested := TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("X"), ty.Int8), TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("Y"), ty.Int16)})
	record := TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("A"), TY.NewArray(ty.Int32, 1)), TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("B"), nested)})
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		t    *types.Type
	}{{"record", record}, {"array", TY.NewArray(record, 1)}, {"empty", TY.NewArray(ty.Int32, 0)}, {"string", ty.String}, {"slice", TY.NewSlice(ty.UInt8)}, {"iface", TY.NewInterface(nil)}, {"complex64", TY.Types[types.TCOMPLEX64]}, {"complex128", TY.Types[types.TCOMPLEX128]}, {"int64", ty.Int64}}
	for _, test := range cases {
		f, fe := fresh()
		e := f.Entry
		e.Reset(BlockIf)
		cond := e.NewValue0(pos, OpArg, ty.Bool)
		e.SetControl(cond)
		left, right, join := f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		left.Pos = pos
		right.Pos = pos
		join.Pos = pos
		e.AddEdgeTo(left)
		e.AddEdgeTo(right)
		left.AddEdgeTo(join)
		right.AddEdgeTo(join)
		mem := e.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		ptr := e.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, TY.NewPtr(test.t), 8)
		bytes := e.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, ty.BytePtr, 16)
		var makeValue func(*Block, *types.Type, int64) *Value
		makeValue = func(b *Block, t *types.Type, k int64) *Value {
			switch {
			case t.IsStruct():
				v := b.NewValue0(pos, OpStructMake, t)
				for _, field := range t.Fields() {
					v.AddArg(makeValue(b, field.Type, k+1))
				}
				return v
			case t.IsArray():
				if t.NumElem() == 0 {
					return b.NewValue0(pos, OpEmpty, t)
				}
				return b.NewValue1(pos, OpArrayMake1, t, makeValue(b, t.Elem(), k+2))
			case t.IsString():
				return b.NewValue2(pos, OpStringMake, t, bytes, constInt(f, k))
			case t.IsSlice():
				return b.NewValue3(pos, OpSliceMake, t, bytes, constInt(f, k), constInt(f, k+5))
			case t.IsInterface():
				return b.NewValue2(pos, OpIMake, t, e.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, ty.Uintptr, k+32), bytes)
			case t.IsComplex():
				if t.Size() == 8 {
					return b.NewValue2(pos, OpComplexMake, t, f.ConstFloat32(ty.Float32, float64(k)+0.25), f.ConstFloat32(ty.Float32, float64(k)+0.5))
				}
				return b.NewValue2(pos, OpComplexMake, t, f.ConstFloat64(ty.Float64, float64(k)+0.25), f.ConstFloat64(ty.Float64, float64(k)+0.5))
			default:
				switch t.Size() {
				case 1:
					return f.ConstInt8(t, int8(k))
				case 2:
					return f.ConstInt16(t, int16(k))
				case 4:
					return f.ConstInt32(t, int32(k))
				case 8:
					return f.ConstInt64(t, 0x1122334455667700+k)
				}
			}
			panic("unsupported fixture type")
		}
		a, z := makeValue(left, test.t, 3), makeValue(right, test.t, 7)
		phi := join.NewValue2(pos, OpPhi, test.t, a, z)
		n := GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("local_"+test.name), test.t)
		n.Class = ir.PPARAM
		slot := &LocalSlot{N: n, Type: test.t}
		f.Names = append(f.Names, slot)
		f.NamedValues[*slot] = []*Value{phi, phi}
		if test.t.Size() != 0 {
			mem = join.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, test.t, ptr, phi, mem)
		}
		join.SetControl(mem)
		finish(test.name, f, fe)
	}
	// Soft-float conversion includes NaN and signed-zero bit patterns. Check only
	// after the mandatory conversion; float values are forbidden in soft mode.
	for _, test := range []struct {
		size  int
		value float64
	}{{4, math.Copysign(0, -1)}, {8, math.Copysign(0, -1)}, {4, math.Float64frombits(0x7ff8123412345678)}, {8, math.Float64frombits(0x7ff8123412345678)}} {
		size, value := test.size, test.value
		f, fe := fresh()
		cfg.SoftFloat = true
		b := f.Entry
		t := ty.Float64
		op := OpNeg64F
		round := OpRound64F
		var constant *Value
		if size == 4 {
			t = ty.Float32
			op = OpNeg32F
			round = OpRound32F
			constant = f.ConstFloat32(t, value)
		}
		if size == 8 {
			constant = f.ConstFloat64(t, value)
		}
		neg := b.NewValue1(pos, op, t, constant)
		v := b.NewValue1(pos, round, t, neg)
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		ptr := b.NewValue0(pos, OpArg, TY.NewPtr(t))
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, t, ptr, v, mem)
		b.SetControl(mem)
		numberLines(f)
		softfloat(f)
		opt(f)
		deadcode(f)
		checkFunc(f)
		add(fmt.Sprintf("soft-%d-%x", size, math.Float64bits(value)), f.String())
		add("soft-splits", fe.splits)
		lower(f)
		lateLower(f)
		deadcode(f)
		checkFunc(f)
		checkLower(f)
		add(fmt.Sprintf("soft-lower-%d-%x", size, math.Float64bits(value)), f.String())
		cfg.SoftFloat = false
	}
	// Explicit block features let us test the native ternary pass independently
	// of the CPU-feature dataflow pass that supplies these bits in Compile.
	for _, enabled := range []bool{false, true} {
		f, _ := fresh()
		b := f.Entry
		t := TY.TypeVec128
		if enabled {
			f.maxCPUFeatures = CPUavx512
			b.CPUfeatures = CPUavx512
		}
		x := b.NewValue0(pos, OpArg, t)
		y := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, t, 16)
		z := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, t, 32)
		a := b.NewValue2(pos, OpOrInt8x16, t, x, y)
		v := b.NewValue2(pos, OpAndInt8x16, t, a, z)
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		ptr := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, TY.NewPtr(t), 48)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, t, ptr, v, mem)
		b.SetControl(mem)
		checkFunc(f)
		numberLines(f)
		rewriteTern(f)
		deadcode(f)
		checkFunc(f)
		add(fmt.Sprint("tern-", enabled), f.String())
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR=" + string(data))
}
